haloField.source: Same finite NFW mass profile and taper as models.js; Float32 effective constants/nodes recorded when GPU mode is used
haloField.interpretation: Static finite material NFW ellipsoid in Newtonian gravity; no relativistic dynamics or geometric mass source.

shape.method: finite homeoidal density; spherical control plus fixed Gauss-Legendre correction; static orientation
shape.coordinate: m²=xprime²+yprime²/p²+zprime²/q²; taper and cutoff in m

mass.geometry: true enclosed spheres; not R vc²/G; ellipsoidal halo integrated over sphere

continuousHaloQuadrature.qualification: finite angular quadrature, not a certified continuum error bar

methods.rotation: direct probes at exact Eilers radii; no interpolation of observations
methods.vertical: signed restoring acceleration averaged at z=+/-1.1 kpc and azimuth; Kz/(2πG) in Msun/pc², not actual surface density
methods.escape: sqrt(2*(mean Phi at 2 R200 - mean local Phi)); instantaneous frozen-potential depth proxy, not an escape invariant in an evolving field
methods.mass: component masses inside true spheres, instantaneous particles plus static halo density
methods.comparison: Same-snapshot removal of halo contribution only; not a separate re-equilibrated baryon-only trajectory. Fixed initial origin/axes. Baryonic parameters not fitted; gas absent; observational systematics not calibrated. No invented uncertainty band or significance.

measurement.precision: GPU Float32 particle force and potential; CPU Float64 continuous external field and reduction

observations.title: The Circular Velocity Curve of the Milky Way from 5 to 25 kpc
observations.errors: Published asymmetric statistical error bars only; systematic uncertainties are not included.
observations.inference: Circular speed inferred using axisymmetric Jeans modelling; not raw mean stellar rotation.
observations.comparison: Consistency comparison. Historical model parameters used related rotation-curve constraints; not an independent out-of-sample test.
